verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents its own financial reporting: it can create financial reports, pull reports via MCP, and customize reports by relative date range. That supports on-demand, period-adjustable reporting. The evidence never names a P&L, balance sheet, or cash-flow statement. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow statements, arbitrary custom-period selection, accuracy guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: Generate invoices, track payments, log expenses, and create financial reports.
